Container.Name: claude-code-unraid
Container.Overview: Claude Code CLI in a Docker container for Unraid server management. Helps with server maintenance, Docker management, troubleshooting, and more.

Config.Name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
Config.Description: Your Anthropic API key. Required for Claude Code to function.

Config.Name: CUSTOM_NODE_OPTIONS
Config.Description: Optional: Custom Node.js options for Claude Code.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Directory where Claude Code will work with your files. This should be your main storage.

Config.Name: Config Directory
Config.Description: Directory for Claude Code configuration, including custom CLAUDE.md file.

Config.Name: Appdata Directory
Config.Description: Directory for Claude Code persistent application data.
